agent.title: Account assistant
agent.noAccount: Connect an Instagram account in Settings to begin.
agent.pauseWarning: Pausing stops new assistant work. Already submitted or uncertain actions keep their outcome tracking; a pause cannot undo them.
agent.connectionRequired: Reconnect the account before enabling or resuming work.
agent.migrationWarning: Changing control cancels unsubmitted work and starts a new ownership period. Existing uncertain operations continue to be reconciled. Delegation stays separate: enabling does not grant permission.
agent.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can change permissions or account control.
agent.managerOnly: Owners and managers can edit voice and goals.
agent.capabilityHint: Availability comes from the connected provider and current grants. Permission settings cannot enable an unavailable capability.
agent.goalsHint: Goals guide the assistant; they do not grant permissions or replace verified business facts.
agent.reloadWarning: Your edits are kept here. Loading the latest saved settings discards these edits so you can review and try again.
agent.reloadCurrent: Discard edits and load current settings
agent.previewDisclosure: Local illustrative sample using your example or tone. It does not run a model, use business facts, or send a message. No model cost.
agent.sample_warm: Assistant: Of course! What would you like to know?
agent.sample_neutral: Assistant: What information do you need?
agent.sample_direct: Assistant: Tell me what you need help with.
agent.delegationHint: Set each action separately. Asking creates an explicit action approval; a business answer never approves an action. Limits and request sources apply to that action only.
agent.changeWarning: Applying invalidates unsubmitted authorizations. Review the exact changes before applying.
agent.taskHint: Ask for work on this account. Preparing content does not approve scheduling or publication. Only your own requests appear here.
agent.taskAccepted: Request recorded. Follow its progress below.
agent.outcomeHint: Only a verified successful operation is complete. Queued and unknown outcomes are still pending.
